what_this_is: Write registers for the shared jsonl ledger surfaces and INDEX.md. A writer is identified by script/process name (env override: HARNESS_WRITER). Registered writers get the modes listed here; the DEFAULT for an unregistered writer is append-only everywhere, rewrite nowhere.
incidents: 2026-10-11: 49 decided triage/proposal decisions destroyed by git checkout -f over a dirty tree (uncommitted-ledger loss class)
2026-10-10: triage/queue.jsonl corruption from whole-file write races (commit 31ac8df; repair file triage/queue.jsonl.pre-repair-2026-10-10)

conventions.append: add lines, never remove or reorder existing ones
conventions.rewrite: whole-file read-modify-write permitted, ONLY under the surface's lock (flock via atomic_io.atomic_write)
conventions.identity: writer name = the script or process doing the write (e.g. 'triage-decide.py'); sessions default to 'unregistered'

surfaces.notes: the liveness heartbeat; run-job.sh writes it mechanically. Timestamp format discipline enforced here since 2026-10-11 (three-format incident).

appends go through queue-append.py; status transitions (whole-file RMW under flock) only by triage-decide.py save() and workato-health.py triage_append. 2026-10-10 corruption and 2026-10-11 checkout -f loss were both this file.
IMMUTABLE audit log of every triage decision; the source of truth triage/queue.jsonl is a projection of (see rebuild-queue.py). Never rewritten, ever.
append-only audit trail of proposal verdicts; mirror of triage-outcomes.
multi-writer append-only build attribution; the 2026-10-09 torn line (line 4837) is why every append is atomic.
value events; rollups are read-time projections, never rewrites.
one outbox per agent; only bus_post.py appends. Archives (.bak-*, .flood-archive-*) are separate files, not rewrites.

appenders: any harness session (one routing line per new domain/project file)
surfaces.notes: sessions APPEND one line per new file; removing/reordering lines is the brain-gardener's architecture pass only. Line-removing edits by anyone else are the checkout -f loss class from 2026-10-11.
in-flight work registry event log (Josh 2026-10-11). Schema-validated via atomic_append_validated inside mission-control.py.
DERIVED projections only — no session hand-edits these (the voices law: state is the event log; views are rebuilt).
